evidence.note: FIRE splits counterspeech generation into two sub-2B Qwen3-1.7B agents -- one that classifies the hate category, names the target group, writes a reasoning trace and triggers a web search for evidence, one that writes the reply -- with specialization coming from a contrastively-trained 22M retrieval encoder over annotated examples rather than from fine-tuning.
evidence.title: Counter with Evidence! A Multi-Agent Memory Efficient Reasoning Framework for Hate Category Informed Counterspeech Generation
